pr_title: GameEngine: add ADR 0135 native inference arbitration
pr_body:
## Summary

- add ADR 0135 for native local-model inference scheduling and Editor GPU resource arbitration
- define Auto/Fast/Balanced/Deep quality intent without model-family or fixed-VRAM lock-in
- define InferenceFocused suspension, staged VRAM reclaim, Deep-only aggressive reclaim, and capability-driven model residency
- preserve ADR 0131 single-model baseline while allowing later benchmark-proven model routing
- keep Stop as cancellation and add a separate resumable Interrupt-for-Editing flow with mandatory re-inspection before Resume
- set RTX 4070 Ti 12 GB as reference benchmark hardware, not a product minimum

## Validation

Documentation-only change; permanent Windows Validation should classify this PR as docs mode. Visual Validation is not applicable.
